document_a.label: CERTIFICATE OF ORIGIN (structured JSON), CertificateId SEG-25D-238671

critical_failures: Consignee mismatch: certificate consignee is Al Ghurair Printing and Publishing LLC, United Arab Emirates, but invoice recipient/delivery fields show Braillo Norway AS and Seafront Logistics AS in Norway.
Quantity mismatch: certificate indicates 30334 kgs gross and 138 reels, while invoice shows 27271,0 gross/net kg and 69 rolls/colli.
overall_assessment.decision_summary: Consignor, goods description and origin can be verified, but consignee and quantity cannot be verified and are contradicted by the invoice.
overall_assessment.human_explanation: Certifikatet anger mottagaren som Al Ghurair Printing and Publishing LLC i Förenade Arabemiraten, medan fakturan visar Braillo Norway AS och Seafront Logistics AS i Norge. Certifikatet anger 30334 kg och 138 rullar, men fakturan anger 27271,0 kg och 69 rullar/kolli. Dokumenten kan därför inte godkännas automatiskt.
